title: FutureRTC: Real-Time Robot Execution with Anticipatory-Conditioned Action Chunking
authors: Hai Jiang, Yixian Zou, Binbin Liang, Boqian Liu, Fanman Meng, Shuaicheng Liu

tldr.en: Predict execution-time visual representations and corrected proprioception; train adaptation modules with policy consistency while keeping the underlying policy unchanged.
tldr.zh: 预测执行时刻的视觉表征并校正本体状态，用策略一致性训练适配模块，保持底层策略不变。

evaluation_scope.en: π0.5/SmolVLA on LIBERO with delay sweeps and real manipulation. The official page states code will be released; unchanged policy does not mean training-free adapters.
evaluation_scope.zh: π0.5/SmolVLA 的 LIBERO 延迟扫描与真机操作。官方项目页标注代码待发布；底层策略不变不等于适配模块免训练。
